run_play_bh_joystick: run the script to deploy an MJX ONNX policy to C MuJoCo and interact with the Berkeley humanoid via gamepad
create_OnnxController: create an OnnxController instance with a policy path, default angles, control dt, and substeps for the Berkeley humanoid
test_OnnxController_get_obs: test the OnnxController.get_obs method to extract observation vectors from MuJoCo model and data
test_OnnxController_get_control: test the OnnxController.get_control method to compute control actions from an ONNX policy and apply them to MuJoCo
review_load_callback: review the load_callback function that initializes the MuJoCo model, data, and OnnxController for the viewer
